question: Ano ang Certificate of Completion of Subdivision at sinong ahensya ang nag-eendorse nito sa DHSUD?
answer: Ang Certificate of Completion of Subdivision ay nagpapahayag na nakapagtapos na ang subdivision project sa kasunduan ng plano na nakalagay sa approval ng Housing and Land Use Regulatory Board (HLURB). Ang ahensya na nag-eendorse nito sa Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development (DHSUD) ay ang City Housing Land Use and Regulatory Unit (CHLURU) bilang nakasaad sa [S2].

ground_truth: The Certificate of Completion of Subdivision (COC) is a resolution from the City Housing Land Use and Regulatory Unit (CHLURU) favorably endorsing to DHSUD/HLURB that the project has been fully completed according to approved engineering plans.
